slides.title: New to Laval? 5 winter rules to know first.
slides.sub: Your first snow season here, from Chomedey to Duvernay.

photo.credit: Île Paton, Chomedey · Photo: Laurent Bélanger, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Winter tires: Dec 1 to Mar 15
slides.body: Every Québec-registered car must be winter-ready. Book your tire swap early, garages get busy in November.

slides.title: Car shelters follow a calendar
slides.body: Laval sets the dates. Keep it **0.6 m** from the curb and **1.5 m** from a fire hydrant.
slides.source: Per Ville de Laval bylaw, November 2026

slides.title: Read the parking signs
slides.body: When crews clear your street, one side closes, usually **8 a.m. to 5 p.m.** Info-Stationnement sends alerts.

slides.title: Your snow stays on your lot

banner.text: No blowing or pushing snow onto the street

slides.body: Laval bans putting snow on the street or sidewalk, contractors included. Fines apply. Keep your hydrant clear too.
slides.source: Per Ville de Laval, Stratégie neige

slides.title: Then get out and enjoy it

photo.credit: Centre de la nature, Duvernay · Photo: Richard Mc Neil, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Centre de la nature in **Duvernay** has skating, tube sliding and cross-country skiing, with rentals on site.

slides.title: Moving to Laval this winter? Let's talk.
slides.tagline: Let's break this down together. No rush.
